headline: Open MS tools tighten annotation, QC and reuse across lipidomics, metabolomics and proteomics
label: Ms Data Annotation And Qc
summary: Six new MS tools and resources target annotation, quality control and data reuse, with several lowering the barrier for non-programmers.
synthesis: The items converge less on proteomics search space than on the downstream layer of mass spectrometry analysis: validating annotations, controlling quality and making results reusable. LipidRT uses retention time coherence to validate and expand lipid annotations in reversed-phase LC-MS. msiFlow 2.0 adds pixel-wise mass recalibration, automated lipid annotation, ComBat batch correction and QC to imaging workflows. MetaboRx flags formatting errors and unreliable features in metabolomics tables, while OSMSS provides no-code differential abundance, phosphosite and enrichment analysis from major search outputs. qPTM 3.0 consolidates fragmented quantitative PTM data, and MetaboLights describes submission, transfer, validation and reuse developments. What is new is the emphasis on explicit quality checks and accessible Shiny front ends rather than new identification algorithms; the items give no evidence of expanded proteomics search spaces.
